declarations.description:
A [Mermaid](https://mermaid.js.org) diagram (flowchart, sequence, class, state, ER, gantt, pie, …) drawn from its
text source, with colours taken from `--c2-mermaid…` variables that map onto the `@c2n/theme` tokens, so diagrams
follow light and dark mode and re-render when those colours change. Mermaid itself is loaded on the first diagram of
the page, not with the element.

The source is treated as untrusted: Mermaid runs at `securityLevel: 'strict'` with plain-text labels, a diagram's
`%%{init}%%` directive cannot change those settings or the theme, and the returned SVG is parsed and stripped of
scripts, foreign objects, event handlers, links and external `url()`/`href` references before it is shown. A source
that does not parse shows its text and the message, and fires `mermaid-error`. Until the diagram is drawn (and on
the server) the source shows as code.
declarations.name: Mermaid

cssProperties.description: Source text shown before the diagram is drawn.
cssProperties.name: --c2-mermaid__source--color

cssProperties.description: Focus ring of a diagram that overflows and scrolls.
cssProperties.name: --c2-mermaid__diagram__focus--outline

cssParts.description: Container of the rendered SVG; scrolls horizontally when the diagram is wider than the element.
cssParts.name: diagram

cssParts.description: The Mermaid source shown as code before the diagram is drawn, and next to the message when it fails.
cssParts.name: source

cssParts.description: The parse or render error message.
cssParts.name: error

members.name: value
members.description: Mermaid source. When unset, the slotted `<script type="text/mermaid">` (or the element's text) is used.

members.name: label
members.description: Accessible name of the diagram. Defaults to the diagram's `accTitle`, then "Diagram".

members.name: svgElement
members.description: The rendered SVG element, for export. `null` before the diagram is drawn or when it failed.

members.name: refresh
members.description: Draws the diagram again, for instance after a theme change the element cannot observe.

events.name: mermaid-render
events.description: A diagram was drawn; `type` is Mermaid's diagram type (`flowchart-v2`, `sequence`, …).

events.name: mermaid-error
events.description: The source failed to parse or render.
